```{r}
library(readr)
library(stringr)

randomletters <- read_lines("https://byuistats.github.io/M335/data/randomletters.txt")
View(randomletters)

randomletters_wnumbers <- read_lines("https://byuistats.github.io/M335/data/randomletters_wnumbers.txt")
View(randomletters_wnumbers)
```

```{r}
rand_letters <- paste0(randomletters, collapse = "")
split <- str_split(rand_letters, pattern = "")[[1]]
quote_letters <- split[c(1, seq(1700, length(split), by = 1700))]
quote <- paste0(quote_letters, collapse = "")
hidden_quote_final <- str_extract(quote, ".*?\\.")
```

```{r}
numbers_string <- paste0(randomletters_wnumbers, collapse = "")
hidden_numbers <- str_extract_all(numbers_string, "\\d+")[[1]]
hidden_numbers <- as.numeric(hidden_numbers)
decoded_letters <- letters[hidden_numbers]
decoded_message <- paste0(decoded_letters, collapse = "")
```

```{r}
clean <- str_remove_all(rand_letters, "[ .]")
vowels <- str_extract_all(clean, "[aeiouAEIOU]+")[[1]]
longest_vowel_sequence <- vowels[which.max(str_length(vowels))]
str_length(longest_vowel_sequence)
```

```{r}
hidden_quote_final
decoded_message
longest_vowel_sequence
```
